summary: The note surveys mobility and transportation startups reshaping how people and goods move, covering software platforms, EVs, autonomous tech, electrification, smart infrastructure, policy, incubators and partnerships. It argues that supportive policy, ecosystems and collaboration between startups and established automakers are key to a coming transportation renaissance.
one_line: Overview of mobility startups in autonomy, electrification and smart infrastructure, and the policy, ecosystem and partnership support they need to scale.
key_facts: GlidePath has developed a software platform that integrates multiple modes of transportation and provides real-time data to help cities manage traffic.
Veloce Innovations is shaking up the EV market with a battery charge lasting up to 25% longer than its nearest competitors.
GlidePath and Veloce Innovations unveiled their visions at the Mobility Tech Summit on September 16th, 2023.
OttoDrive, founded by veteran engineer Samantha Chu, had a successful pilot in Pittsburgh showing a drastic reduction in commute times and accidents.
QuickDrop Robotics pioneers autonomous delivery vehicles with a drone deployment system aimed at last-mile delivery.
Bolt Energy, established on January 15, 2024, builds a network of high-speed, solar-powered charging stations.
SolarDrive has patented solar roof panels for cars that can retrofit existing vehicles.
RoadSense, based in Austin, Texas, has made sensor-laden roads that communicate with vehicles since September 2023.
MobilityHive provides municipalities with cloud-based solutions to synchronize traffic signals and reduce urban congestion.
Dr. Erica Lindstrom, a transportation policy advisor, called for "forwardthinking regulations" at a policy forum on September 20, 2023.
The TranspoTech Incubator was established in Los Angeles on February 12, 2024, offering mentorship, technical support and industry connections.
MotorFleet and bike-sharing service WheelEase announced a collaboration on September 10, 2023 to integrate WheelEase's tech into MotorFleet's vehicle lineup.
Ampere Motors' electric scooters are gaining popularity in urban environments as eco-friendly and affordable.
